facts.fact: Decree 2018-146 makes the ANPI one-stop shop the sole place for company creation, required to run on an integrated information system and single payment, with registrations published on the ODPIC and one-stop websites.
The Prime Minister states that with the platform launched on 26 January 2026 a person can create a company entirely online.
The entreprendre.dj guide says firms register in the commercial register (RCS) through the ANPI one-stop counter (Guichet Unique), in 72 hours at 23,000 FDJ; it does not say registration is online.

systems.system: Guichet Unique ANPI / Registre du Commerce (RCS)

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Djibouti's ICT ministry launched design work on 15 December 2025 for an integrated G2B platform meant to simplify business creation, with a digital G2B counter and the existing one-stop shop to be extended to administrative services and e-payments.

note: The document covers civil registration only and states nothing about this register for Djibouti.
